events.title: ECSTATIC HEAVEN at The Jungle Club
events.description: Awakened Dreamers brings ECSTATIC HEAVEN back to The Jungle Club's open-air jungle space in Sayan for September — an alcohol-free conscious dance gathering in the trees. The format: ethnic live-electronic music and mystic live sound, a three-hour ecstatic dance floor, and a community lounge. Awakened Dreamers has run conscious dance nights in Ubud across 2026, with the monthly Jungle Club series anchoring their season.
events.short_description: Open-air ecstatic dance in Sayan's jungle canopy — Awakened Dreamers' monthly conscious gathering at The Jungle Club.
